recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle outdoor portrait of three men standing on a grassy rise against a clear blue sky. The composition features a mix of casual 1960s fashion including turtlenecks and denim, with bold, stacked sans-serif typography occupying the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouettes against a vast, uniform sky background
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of stature
Right-aligned text block balancing the left-weighted subjects
High-contrast drop shadows on text for depth
coreInvariants: Natural outdoor lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures positioned from left to center, occupying approximately two-thirds of the horizontal frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in dark clothing acts as a vertical anchor, while the bright green text serves as the primary focal point for information.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces of the subjects on the left, move across to the bold green text, and descend through the white secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper sky area allows for prominent typographic placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue background providing a clean, cool canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark silhouettes of clothing (black, dark blue) and earthy brown ground.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lime green for the primary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the green text against a muted, naturalistic photographic palette.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different colors and weights to distinguish title from artist.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed proportions.
Provides the clean mid-century modernist look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photograph of three men in 1960s attire (denim jacket, black turtleneck, blue knit turtleneck) standing on a grassy hill against a clear, solid blue sky. The lighting should be natural daylight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, stacked uppercase text in the upper right quadrant using a heavy condensed sans-serif. The top lines should be lime green with a black drop shadow; the bottom lines should be white with a black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle low, looking up at the subjects?
Is the text right-aligned and stacked?
Does the primary text have a lime green fill and black drop shadow?
Is the background a clear blue sky?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of blue for the sky
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for right-alignment of all text blocks
Ensure the green text is significantly larger than the white text
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained
Confirm the absence of any modern logos or branding
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle trio portrait + clear sky background + right-aligned condensed sans-serif + lime/white color split + hard drop shadows.
